recent_en: APM announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 19 November 2026, with net profit up 29.5% year-on-year, mainly due to a RM9.0 million acquisition gain, despite a 15.3% decline in revenue. The company declared an interim single-tier dividend of 5 sen per share, with ex-date on 10 September 2026. Separately, on 17 September 2026, APM announced recurrent related party transactions with Tan Chong Motor Holdings Berhad and Warisan TC Holdings Berhad groups, with the total value exceeding 1% of the group's net assets.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 19 November 2026, with net profit up 29.5% year-on-year and revenue down 15.3%.
Declared an interim single-tier dividend of 5 sen per share for the financial year ending 31 December 2026.

Announced recurrent related party transactions with Tan Chong Motor Holdings Berhad and Warisan TC Holdings Berhad groups on 17 September 2026, with total value exceeding 1% of the group's net assets.
